messages:
DeployBot: release/redwood-sdk@v3.8.0 started to canary (canary=10%) to us-west-2 at 1769456789
Alice Chen: seeing a spike in 502s on paging API from canary clients, rolling back?
Raj Patel: confirmed, paging requests are hitting frame-decode errors, looks like client frame enum changed in v3.8.0
Jordan Kim: logs show: `ERROR decode_frame: unexpected enum value 7` across most streaming sessions
Maya Lopez: Support is getting a handful of P0 tickets from enterprise customers, one reports stream drop + repeated reconnects :grimacing:
SRE Oncall: oncall-trigger invoked by Oncall Bot — assigning page to SRE Oncall and Eng Platform
Oncall Bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423, severity: partial outage (paged streaming degraded)
Support Lead: escalating to product ops — need customer impact summary and which customers hit the canary
Raj Patel: looks like a protocol bump in the SDK where we added a new frame type for 'checkpoint' without backward compat checks. server runtime treats unknown enum as fatal
Jordan Kim: repro steps (canary): `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -d @payload localhost:8080/stream` -> server logs same decode error
Eng Platform: hold any further canaries immediately and flip deploy gate to paused
DeployBot: canary paused by Eng Platform at 1769456901
Alice Chen: mitigation options: immediate rollback of the canary, or opt to flip a compatibility feature-flag we shipped in runtime (ff:allow-unknown-frames=false) to true to treat unknown frames as ignore
SRE Oncall: what is impact if we flip the flag? any risk to correctness?
Raj Patel: flipping to ignore unknown frames will keep streams alive but will silently drop any new checkpoint frames (non-critical right now). lower risk vs rollback which will increase customer churn from session resets
Product Ops: Support, prepare templated message: affected customers will see stream interruptions or reconnects for SDK v3.8 clients. We should notify any customers with early canary enrolment
Support Lead: pulling list of canary customers now — handing off to Maya for outreach
Maya Lopez: pinging top-10 canary customers, drafting message now. ETA 12m
SRE Oncall: if we go flag-first, need exact FF key + rollout command
Raj Patel: FF key: `runtime.allow_unknown_frames` default=false. set true in configmap `runtime-config-canary`. patch:
```
kubectl -n inference patch configmap runtime-config-canary --patch '{"data":{"runtime.allow_unknown_frames":"true"}}'
```
SRE Oncall: applying now
SRE Oncall: applied `runtime.allow_unknown_frames=true` to canary pool at 1769457050
Alice Chen: monitoring metrics
a few mins later —
Jordan Kim: error rate on streaming decode drops to baseline, reconnects stop for canary subset :thumbsup:
DeployBot: canary health check passed at 1769457280
Product Ops: decision: hold full rollout until SDK fix lands. Plan: keep FF true for canary pool only, rollback the canary expansion, and coordinate SDK patch release for 3.8.1 with safe enum handling + backward compat
Alice Chen: initiating canary rollback expansion kill-switch — preventing further canary ramp
DeployBot: aborted canary expansion and set kill-switch flag `canary-expand=false` at 1769457352
Support Lead: customer outreach sent to 9 canary customers, two replied requiring higher-touch remediation; capturing in INC-2026-0423 notes
Maya Lopez: noted customers CUST-819 and CUST-1024 want session replays; ops to offer temporary workspace with `runtime.allow_unknown_frames=true` in their region
Raj Patel: branch created for 3.8.1 with conservative frame parsing, added golden unit tests for unknown enum handling
Jordan Kim: will ship patch and coordinate with Eng Platform to toggle FF back to false after server-side fix verified
SRE Oncall: recommended to keep flag scoped to canary pool only and set TTL of 72h if not reverted
Eng Platform: scheduled rollout of 3.8.1 canary to private staging + integration tests, target deploy 1769462000
Product Ops: postmortem owner assigned: Alice Chen, due EOD + follow-up to customers
Support Lead: closing influx of P0s, moving to support-incident channel for tickets
Alice Chen: quick timeline for the incident: root cause -> SDK v3.8 introduced new frame enum without graceful server fallback. Mitigation -> feature flag to ignore unknown frames and abort canary expansion. Next -> SDK patch + improved release checklist for protocol changes
Jordan Kim: after action items: (1) SDK release note requirement for protocol bumps, (2) server runtime to log non-fatal unknown frames instead of hard-fail for a deprecation period, (3) add canary smoke test that uses mixed-version client bursts
Oncall Bot: handoff: Eng Platform will take post-deploy watch for 4 hours, SRE Oncall returns to standby at 1769458420
Eng Platform: acknowledged, will monitor.
Alice Chen: thanks all — major thanks to SRE Oncall and Support for rapid mitigation. filing incident ticket and postmortem now :heart:
